**分诊路由(本评论来自分诊座位)· R+150 · `date -u` 实测 2026-09-04T19:50:52Z**

`domain:spec` · `tests` + `finding` · `priority:p3`。

**落点**:`packages/spec/src/ui/action-row-update.test.ts` ⇒ `packages/spec`(单一属主)⇒ `domain:spec`。`tests` 而非 `bug`:交付物是一个夹具字符串,**没有任何行为**依赖它(卡面已证:`target` 是 `z.string()`,该断言只测 `type: 'api'` 形还能 parse)。

**p3 判据**:卡面自己把降级理由说全了 —— 无门禁变红、无行为影响、且**该夹具不发布**(`@objectstack/spec` 只 ship `dist/**` 与 `src/**/*.zod.ts`,`.test.ts` 两者都不匹配)。⇒ 代价只有一致性。

⭐ 但那个一致性代价是具体的,值得写下来:PR #15098 修正了紧挨着它的 docblock 之后,**这一行会成为仓里最后一个拼写错误路径的地方** —— 于是一个 grep `sys_api_key` 找可用范例的作者或 agent 会同时看到一处已改、一处未改,**而没有任何标记说明哪个是对的**。⇒ 这正是母卡在讲的「自信地从错文本推理」,只是少了那个 404 来兜底。

⚠️ 卡面给的两个修法本席都不选(⛔ 不代裁),但提醒一句:第二个(换成一望即知是示意的值)在**防 AI 犯错**这一棱上更强 —— 它让这一行**不可能**再被当成可用范例;第一个只是让它变成第二个正确范例,而正确范例已经有了。

**Oldest-first pass over the ungraded-finding backlog.** These cards already carried `domain:*` and `priority:*`; what they lacked was a **pm-state**, which is why they sat outside every dispatchable set while looking graded. `finding` comes off in the same write.

Triage: `domain:spec` and `priority:p3` confirmed; **type `Bug`, `pm:queue`.**

`packages/spec/src/ui/action-row-update.test.ts:155-159` — the **positive control** of the row-level declarative-write suite — spells `/api/v1/sys_api_key/{id}`, the pre-fix data-API path, while the shipped door is `PATCH /api/v1/data/:object/:id` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:7664`, composing `getApiBasePath()`).

⭐ **That it is the *positive control* is the whole point.** A positive control is the line a reader copies to learn the correct shape — so a wrong path there teaches the wrong path with the authority of a passing test. And it **keeps passing**, because `ActionSchema` validates the action's shape and not the URL's existence. ⇒ Nothing will ever redden.

⚠️ ⛔ Do not "fix" this by making the schema validate data-API paths. That would be a new refusal on a published schema, not this card. Correct the control's spelling.

`priority:p3` stands: no behaviour is wrong, no gate is red, and the cost is one misleading example.

⇒ Both halves hold, and the card's central claim is now **measured true**: with #15098 landed, this fixture is the **last live site in `packages/**` spelling the wrong shape**. ⚠️ Falsify all of it on your own merge base anyway.

## Direction — the newest triage comment rules, and it is quoted rather than paraphrased

The card offers two fixes and says "Deliberately not decided here". Triage has since spoken (2026-09-10T19:30Z):

> ⭐ **That it is the *positive control* is the whole point.** A positive control is the line a reader copies to learn the correct shape — so a wrong path there teaches the wrong path with the authority of a passing test. And it **keeps passing**, because `ActionSchema` validates the action's shape and not the URL's existence. ⇒ Nothing will ever redden.
>
> ⚠️ ⛔ Do not "fix" this by making the schema validate data-API paths. That would be a new refusal on a published schema, not this card. **Correct the control's spelling.**

⇒ **Default: correct the spelling** to the shipped shape, matching the corrected docblock at `action.zod.ts:1403` — path *and* placeholder convention, since `{id}` is also wrong against `target`'s documented `${ctx.X}` / `${param.X}` form.

⭐ The earlier triage comment (2026-09-04) recorded, without choosing, that the card's **second** option — replace the value with something obviously illustrative — is stronger on the anti-AI-error axis, *"它让这一行**不可能**再被当成可用范例;第一个只是让它变成第二个正确范例,而正确范例已经有了"*. You may take that option **only** if you measure the first to be actively misleading, and then you must say so with the measurement. ⛔ Otherwise the newest triage comment governs.

## ⛔ Hard fences

- ⛔ **Do not touch `ActionSchema`.** Adding any path validation is a new refusal on a published schema — triage named that explicitly as not this card. The deliverable is a **string in a fixture**.
- ⛔ `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:8775` carries the same wrong path as a historical record. **Never rewritten.** A changelog is true about the past.
- ⛔ `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts` and any `packages/spec/src/**/*.test.ts` pinning a **union-branch author-visible message** belong to **#15423**, in flight in this same seat right now. ⚠️ Your file *is* a spec test file, so this fence is live, not theoretical: before you touch anything else in it, confirm your edit is the fixture string and nothing that round would also be writing. If you believe you need more, ⛔ stop and report.
- ⛔ `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` belongs to **#15052**; ⛔ `packages/spec/src/contracts/**` belongs to **#15389**. Both in flight.
- ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.
- Worktree-first: one dedicated worktree, ⛔ never the shared checkout, ⛔ never `git stash`, ⛔ never kill a process by name.

## What the round owes beyond the one string

**An ablation that proves the fixture is inert to the assertion.** The card and both triage passes assert that `target` is `z.string()`, so nothing reddens whatever the path says — which is exactly why this sat unnoticed. Prove it: mutate the path to something plainly absurd and show the suite still passes, with a lit control that the suite *can* redden. ⭐ If it turns out something **does** pin that string, the card's whole premise changes and this becomes a report, ⛔ not a commit.

Both defects went in one move — the missing `/data` segment and the placeholder convention (`{id}` was `newTabUrl`'s form; `target` documents `${ctx.X}` / `${param.X}`) — and the result is shape-identical to the corrected twin docblock at `action.zod.ts:1403`. `ActionSchema` untouched, as triage required. Closing.

## ⭐ What this round is worth remembering for

**It declined the card's alternative, and declined it on a measurement that pointed the other way.** The card offered a second option — replace the path with something obviously illustrative — and the earlier triage comment noted it scores better on the anti-AI-error axis. The order allowed it **only** on evidence that option 1 was actively misleading. The round measured and found the opposite: after this fix, **no source file under `packages/**` spells the pre-fix shape at all**, the sole survivor being the fenced `CHANGELOG.md:8775` historical record. ⇒ There is no second, wrong example left to be confused with, so the "two examples, one right one wrong, nothing marking which" cost this card was filed about is simply gone. ⛔ It took the default direction because the evidence pointed there, ⛔ not because the default was easier.

**The ablation this card actually owed, with the half most rounds skip.** The premise — `target` is `z.string()`, so the fixture is inert, which is *why* nobody noticed — was driven to a reading instead of asserted:

```
LEG 1  target := 'ABSURD::::not-a-url::::@@@@/nowhere/{{{'   31 passed, exit 0   ⇒ the string IS inert
LEG 2  LIT CONTROL: type:'api' := 'NOT_AN_ACTION_TYPE'        1 failed | 30 passed, exit 1   ⇒ the suite CAN redden
```

⚠️ Leg 1 alone would have been worthless — "nothing went red" is indistinguishable from "nothing ran". The lit control is what makes the inertness a measurement. Each mutation was proven on disk before its colour was read; the restore was proven **by state** (`git hash-object` back to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty), ⛔ never by an exit code.

**`skip-changeset` measured on the published artifact, not argued from `files[]`.** `npm pack --dry-run --json` on the freshly built package enumerates **2011** files; the edited file is absent and so is every other `.test.ts` — **0 of 2011** — with its published twin `src/ui/action.zod.ts` present as the lit control. ⭐ Then the content check most rounds skip: a token unique to the test file scores **0** across all 2011 published files while a control token from published source scores **61** on the same corpus ⇒ no generated artifact re-authors it.

⚠️ Occurrence counts throughout used `grep -o | wc -l`, ⛔ never `grep -c`, which counts lines and would have voided the readings.
